name: Hazar Shual
overview: Hazar Shual is identified in Scripture as a town located in the southern region of Judah, mentioned specifically in Joshua 15:28, Joshua 19:3, and Nehemiah 11:27. These references consistently associate Hazar Shual with other southern towns such as Beersheba, highlighting its geographical and tribal significance within the land allotted to Judah. The repeated mention of Hazar Shual in these passages underscores its role as part of the settled communities in Judah during the periods of conquest and restoration.
